description: This file defines metrics collection for the konnectivity client in Kubernetes, including metric types, registration, and observation functions.

classes.name: ClientMetrics
classes.description: Struct holding Prometheus metrics for the konnectivity client, including counters and gauges for packets, errors, dial failures, and connections.

methods.name: newMetrics
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new ClientMetrics instance with Prometheus metrics.

methods.name: RegisterMetrics
methods.description: Registers all client metrics with a Prometheus registerer.

methods.name: LegacyRegisterMetrics
methods.description: Registers metrics using a custom registration function, for legacy support.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all metrics in the ClientMetrics instance.

methods.name: ObserveDialFailure
methods.description: Increments the dial failure counter for a given reason.

methods.name: GetClientConnectionsMetric
methods.description: Returns the gauge vector for client connections.

methods.name: ObservePacket
methods.description: Records a packet observation for metrics.

methods.name: ObserveStreamErrorNoPacket
methods.description: Records a stream error that occurred without a packet.

methods.name: ObserveStreamError
methods.description: Records a stream error associated with a specific packet type.
